dedupe_keys.name: principado de asturias wildfire hazard datasets

description: Principado de Asturias: wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Principado de Asturias. Coverage: Principado de Asturias. The listing groups 20 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Número de incendios forestales y superficie afectada según causa- 2018; Número de incendios forestales y superficie afectada según causa- 2011; Número de incendios forestales y superficie afectada según causa- 2016; Número de incendios forestales y superficie afectada según causa- 2015. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es_ES). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
